name: Austral-Serac
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by massive canyon systems. Beyond bioluminescent seas, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Glass-bladed grasses chime across the plains whenever the wind finds its voice.
Surveyors date the monolithic structures of unknown origin to before the region's last cataclysm, which should be impossible. The structures are unweathered, as if time skipped this place.
The artifact market prices fragments from this world like scripture. Provenance papers are forged in three systems, badly.
